name: io.github.daochild/aifinpay
title: AiFinPay
description: Pay for any HTTP API in stablecoins on Polygon and Solana with one MCP call.

environmentVariables.name: AIFINPAY_AGENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Base58 Ed25519 secret (persistent agent identity; Solana + EVM addresses both derive from it)

environmentVariables.name: AIFINPAY_MAX_USD
environmentVariables.description: Hard cap per paid call (agent_call + payable_fetch), default 0.10

environmentVariables.name: AIFINPAY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the AiFinPay backend endpoint, default https://aifinpay.io
